description: Render a Delta Signal audio signature (WAV, 48 kHz) that hides your message: in the heartbeat rhythm, as text in the spectrogram, as an inaudible watermark, and optionally as an SSTV picture, a ggwave data chirp or modem tones. Returns a download link (kept 7 days) and a manifest. Survives YouTube-grade AAC/Opus.

layers.description: Per-layer options: bed, heartbeat, primes, glyph {band: mid|hi}, watermark {payload}

preset.description: Named preset: expands to a layer + sting bundle. Explicit options override the preset.

seed.description: Watermark key; keep it to verify later

name: render_signature
